description: The full, sourced record for one id from search: "country:panama" (its summary; every short topic in full, such as tax, banking, property and inheritance tax, cost of living, safety, healthcare, passport, military service, firearms, renunciation and citizenship by descent; and an index of its programs, cities and tax-list status with ids to fetch. Pass topics for the full rows of any topic), "program:panama-pensionado" (requirements, minimums, stay rules, timelines, fees, legal citations), "city:mexico/merida", "club:…", "golf:…", "project:…", "event:…", "service:…", "bloc:mercosur" (settlement agreement), "jurisdiction:Cayman Islands" (tax blacklist status) or "about" (data coverage and citation terms). A bare country or program name also works.

id.description: An id from search, e.g. "country:costa-rica" or "program:panama-friendly-nations-visa"; or a country or program name.

topics.description: For a country: the full rows of these topics. Omit for the digest (short topics in full, programs, cities and tax lists as ids to fetch).

name: fetch
title: Fetch a complete record
